images.title: Finding 1.4 on the line
images.purpose: Show 1.4 as the 4th mark after 1 when the unit from 1 to 2 is split into 10 equal parts.
images.composition: A long number line across the centre with one highlighted point; a small zoom strip under the first gap.
exact_structure: A horizontal number line from 1 to 2 with 11 marks (1, then 9 small marks, then 2), i.e. 10 equal parts. Only 1, 1.1, 1.4 and 2 are labelled.
The first 4 parts after 1 are shaded amber (#E69F00) as a thin band above the line, with a bracket labelled 4 tenths.
The mark 1.4 is a large reddish purple (#CC79A7) dot labelled 1.4.

Below, a smaller strip between 1 and 1.1 split into 10 equal parts (9 small ticks) in grey (#6B7280), end labels 1 and 1.1, with two light dashed grey lines linking it to the gap between 1 and 1.1 on the main line, and a label each part is 0.01.
rejection: the main line has other than 10 equal parts between 1 and 2
the purple dot is not on the 4th mark after 1
the zoom strip has other than 10 parts
any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A tenth decimal sits at a counted mark, and zooming into one gap shows the hundredths.
images.description: A number line from 1 to 2 with 1.4 marked at the fourth part, and a zoom strip of the gap from 1 to 1.1.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Count 4 parts from 1, then look at the zoom strip.

image_decisions.why: The line shows where 1.4 sits and what lies between 1 and 1.1.
